customer.business: Collabo (creator side): a marketplace where creators sell brand-deal packages, get paid through escrow, and get growth tools
customer.target: US content creators on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube with 1,000 to 300,000 followers who want paid brand deals

behaviours.name: Inbound only
behaviours.how: Waits for brands to email or DM; gets a few offers a month, mostly free product.

behaviours.name: Hustler
behaviours.how: Pitches brands every week and keeps a rate card in a Notion page or Beacons.

behaviours.name: Burned by late payment
behaviours.how: Has chased a brand for weeks to get paid.

behaviours.name: Already on Collabstr
behaviours.how: Has a Collabstr profile and has booked a few deals there.

behaviours.name: Growth-obsessed
behaviours.how: Studies analytics, hooks and trends; growing followers matters more than deals right now.

behaviours.name: Has a manager
behaviours.how: A manager or agency negotiates deals and takes 15-20%.

pitch:
Collabo: a website and phone app where you list brand-deal packages at your own prices (for example "1 TikTok, $500"), and small businesses book you or you pitch on their posted briefs.
The brand puts the full payment in escrow before you start. A draft approval releases 30% to you, the rest is released when the live post is approved, and if the brand doesn't respond within 3-5 days the money is released to you automatically.
A rate tool compares your prices with similar creators and flags if you're underpriced. Free growth tools: a path for your stage (under 5K, 5K-100K, 100K+ followers), analytics on your hooks, editing and posting days, a hook scorer, and trend tracking.
Pricing: free to join. Collabo keeps 10% of what you earn, so on a $500 deal you receive $450. It is a new platform, so the number of brands is still small.
When answering price questions, give Collabo's cut from you, in dollars, on a $500 deal (today it is $50).
